notes: Quick match is now 'Quick match (single)': it never joins a series (FT) room and a room it opens stays a single match. In a series that is not over, the standing is posted in the room chat and 준비 is pressed for you once your game has closed, so the next match starts by itself. A match decided on penalties closes after 3 seconds instead of 5, and a shoot-out stopped by the 8-minute limit no longer decides a series.
